unresolved_gaps: No admitted record establishes Musk's contribution to the reversal of the federal advanced-AI safeguards, beyond his association with the administration.
The contemporaneous NIST reporting establishes threatened cuts and uncertainty, not completed losses of AI Safety Institute capability by the post date.
The strongest concrete Musk-linked example concerns vehicle-automation oversight; whether that settles the speaker's broader reference to the cause of AI safety depends on an unstated scope.
The vehicle-automation evidence is a secondary account, gives only February timing, and does not establish the full effect on safety work.
